name: Native-zero Chord with learned modulation scales
tagline: Learn the modulation strength for each read, position update and velocity write.
description: Zero-initialized h-only token projections modulate static Chord logits. Each control family has a learned scale that starts at 0.01. Branch output projections start at zero.
mechanism: Three learned scales per consumed site with separate learning rates for static biases and dynamic controls
limitations: Bounded 8,000-update research comparison on the reference schedule.
